input.content:
# Task Summary: T01 — Update web/lib files

**Feature:** F002 — Status filter and search
**Task ID:** T01
**Status:** done

## Goal

Implement changes in `web/app/page.tsx` and `web/lib/filter.ts` to add status filtering and text search to the reading list page.

## Changes Made

### add
- `web/lib/filter.ts` — New file with `filterItems()` function and `FilterOptions` type

### chg
- `web/app/page.tsx` — Added status filter links, text search form, and URL `searchParams`-based filtering

## What Was Implemented

### `web/lib/filter.ts`
- `FilterOptions` interface with optional `status` (`ReadingListStatus`) and `query` (`string`) fields
- `filterItems(items, options)` pure function:
  - Filters by `status` if provided (exact match on `ReadingListStatus`)
  - Filters by `query` if provided (case-insensitive substring match on `title`)
  - Returns all items when neither option is set (AND logic when both are set)

### `web/app/page.tsx`
- Now accepts `searchParams` prop (Next.js Promise-based pattern) for `status` and `q` (query) URL params
- Status filter: row of links (`All`, `to-read`, `reading`, `done`) that set/clear the `status` param while preserving the current query
- Search form: HTML `<form method="GET">` with text input, hidden status preservation, and a "Clear search" link
- Empty state messaging: shows "No items match your filter." when filtered, "No items yet." when no items exist at all
- Filters are applied server-side via `searchParams`, making filtered views shareable/bookmarkable

## Acceptance Criteria Coverage

| AC | Status | Evidence |
|----|--------|----------|
| AC1 — Status filter control | done | Status links rendered for `All`, `to-read`, `reading`, `done`; sets `?status=` param |
| AC2 — Text search input | done | Search form with `name="q"` for query param; case-insensitive match via `filterItems` |
| AC3 — Combined filter/search (AND) | done | `filterItems` applies both filters; form preserves status as hidden input |
| AC4 — No filter = all items | done | `filterItems` returns all items when both `status` and `query` are undefined |
| AC5 — No changes to API/store/data files | done | Only `web/app/page.tsx` and `web/lib/filter.ts` modified; no changes to `web/app/api/items/route.ts`, `web/lib/store.ts`, or `web/data/reading-list.json` |
| AC6 — Build and lint pass | done | Both `pnpm --dir web run lint` and `pnpm --dir web run build` pass with zero errors |

## Commands Executed

1. `pnpm --dir web run lint` — **pass** (no errors)
2. `pnpm --dir web run build` — **pass** (compiled successfully, TypeScript clean, all pages generated)

## Boundary Compliance

All changes stayed within the approved boundary:
- **Touch files edited:** `web/app/page.tsx`, `web/lib/filter.ts`
- **No changes to blocked files:** `web/app/api/`, `web/app/add/`, `web/app/layout.tsx`, `web/next.config.ts`, `web/eslint.config.mjs`, `web/next-env.d.ts`, `web/lib/store.ts`, `web/lib/types.ts`

## Test Notes

No tests were added — the project has no test framework or test script configured in `web/package.json`, and the spec constraint prohibits new npm dependencies. The verification commands (lint + build) serve as the primary verification evidence.

## Review Iterations

_None._

All done. Here's the summary:

## T01 — Update web/lib files: **done**

### Changes Made

**`web/lib/filter.ts`** (new) — Pure filter utility with:
- `FilterOptions` type (`status?: ReadingListStatus`, `query?: string`)
- `filterItems(items, options)` — applies status filter (exact match) and/or text search (case-insensitive substring on title) as an AND; returns all items when neither is set

**`web/app/page.tsx`** (modified) — URL-driven filtering with:
- **Status filter links** — `All`, `to-read`, `reading`, `done` — set `?status=` param, preserve current search query
- **Text search form** — `<form method="GET">` with `name="q"`, hidden input to preserve status, and "Clear search" link
- **Server-side filtering** via Next.js `searchParams` prop (Promise-based), making filtered views shareable/bookmarkable
- **Empty state messages** — "No items match your filter." vs "No items yet."
